prompt:

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 5 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:

- the box in the middle row of boxes, third position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a heap of gold coins with a few red and blue gems on a stone floor.
- the box in the middle row of boxes, fourth position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a golden crown resting on a red velvet cushion on a short carved stone pedestal.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, first position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a carved dark wooden lectern holding a large open book.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, second position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a world globe in brass on a wooden stand.
